items.problem: Leftover Windows.UI.Colors (named colors) survived the bootstrap namespace rewrite and caused a CS0234 build failure that cascaded into XamlCompiler WMC0909/WMC1111 errors.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 26 lines 2491-2497 (CS0234 + WMC0909); Initialize output line 213 rewrote only Windows.UI.Xaml.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 mass-rewrite only handles Windows.UI.Xaml; the documented sibling Windows.UI.Colors relocation is not mechanized, so it is left for manual discovery via a build error.
items.change: Extend the bootstrap mass-rewrite to also convert Windows.UI.Colors -> Microsoft.UI.Colors (leaf static class; '\b' guard leaves the Windows.UI.Color struct untouched).
items.expected_effect: Windows.UI.Colors references are rewritten during bootstrap, so no CS0234 and no downstream XAML cascade on re-run.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any sample using named colors, dotnet build emits no "CS0234 ... 'Colors' does not exist in the namespace 'Windows.UI'" and the Initialize summary line reports Windows.UI.Colors rewrites.

items.problem: The validator only catches leftover Windows.UI.Xaml residue, not the other non-Xaml Windows.UI.* namespaces that also relocate to Microsoft.UI.*.
items.evidence: Validate residue grep passed (session-log line 2948) despite the earlier Colors build break — because Colors/Text/Composition/Input are not in the residue set.
items.root_cause: unsupported-api-inventory.json residueOnly (and the validator fallback) lack a pattern for non-Xaml Windows.UI.* runtime namespaces that need manual rewrite.
items.change: Add a residue pattern Windows.UI.(Colors|Text|Composition|Input)\b (with a reason pointing to the Namespace Mapping table) to unsupported-api-inventory.json residueOnly and to the Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 fallback list.
items.expected_effect: Any leftover Text/Composition/Input (or Colors, if bootstrap ever misses it) is reported by the validator before the build, with a pointer to the mapping table.
items.falsifiable_check: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 run against a project containing e.g. Windows.UI.Text.FontWeights reports a residue hit named 'Windows.UI.* (non-Xaml runtime namespace)'; it does NOT flag the Windows.UI.Color struct or Windows.UI.Xaml.Input.

items.problem: The CS0234 cascaded into XamlCompiler WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType' / WMC1509 'No LocalAssembly', which reads like an x:DataType bug but is a downstream effect of the failed C# build.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 26 lines 2494-2497; fixing only the C# error cleared all XAML errors (BUILD_EXIT=0, line 2933) with no XAML change.
items.root_cause: The x:Bind troubleshooting note only covers XLS0414/MC3074 and does not explain the MarkupCompilePass2 cascade, and the mapping-table heading under-states which Windows.UI.* rows are auto-applied.
items.change: Clarify the Namespace Mapping intro (auto-applied Xaml+Colors vs. manual non-Xaml rows; CS0234 -> WMC0909 cascade warning) and add a WMC0909/WMC1509 'fix C# first' note to the x:Bind troubleshooting section. Tier-1 tooling fixes the mechanics; this prose prevents wasted turns interpreting the cascade, which tooling cannot convey.
items.expected_effect: Agents that still hit a residual non-Xaml Windows.UI.* error interpret the XAML cascade correctly and fix the C# root cause first.
items.falsifiable_check: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md contains a note that WMC0909/WMC1509 during MarkupCompilePass2 indicates a failed C# compile; the Namespace Mapping section states which namespaces the bootstrap auto-rewrites.

deferred_to_human: Eval-side: locked-screen sessions prevent actuating legacy UWP apps (no inner UIA tree on CoreWindow), forcing source-derived behavioral goldens. This is a uwp-app-runner / harness limitation, out of scope for the migration skill.
